title: Integrity-protected evidence chain
note: External witnessing or anchoring for evidence chain heads strongly recommended.

title: Key custody and rotation
note: Strict rotation schedule and documented compromise playbook required.

title: Verifier independence
note: Independent verification tooling or documented process required.

title: Minimum event fields for evidence objects
note: Monotonic sequencing and cross-node ordering strategy required.

title: Replay and duplication detection
note: Replay detection must be demonstrated, not only documented.

title: Controlled invocation surface
note: Strict network policy; enforcement layer must be the only invocation path.

title: Threat model declaration
note: All four attacker class categories must be addressed.

title: Auditor access governance
note: Audited evidence access with export controls required.

title: Retention-by-class policy
note: Retention policy must align to jurisdiction and criticality.

title: Bypass test suite
note: Quarterly adversarial bypass tests plus registry tampering simulations required.

title: Evidence reconstruction drill
note: Semi-annual drills; at least one must assume vendor tooling unavailable.

title: Kill-switch test and dual-control enforcement
note: Dual-control enforced; live-fire exercise in controlled environment required.
